panels.title: CPU & memory over time
panels.description: Average cpu_load / memory_used from sensor_poll (170,242 docs, live today) over the last 90d. FIXES a bug: the prior committed panel OR'd in system_metrics_snapshot, which is dead test-harness pollution -- its 220 docs all come from logger=test_elasticsearch_logging (last emitted 2026-06-20), and it uses different field names (cpu_percent/memory_percent) that never matched this panel's cpu_load/memory_used aggregations anyway, so those docs silently contributed zero data. Rebuilt against sensor_poll alone. Verified live: avg CPU ~6.2%, avg memory ~55.8% over the last 24h (matches the VPS's 8 vCPU / ~10GiB envelope) -- system is healthy.

panels.title: Error events by type
panels.description: Count of error/failure events over time, broken down by event_type (top 10), using a self-adapting wildcard query -- event_type:*error* or event_type:*failed*, excluding error_monitor_* (the error-scanner's own housekeeping events, not actual failures). FIXES a staleness bug: the prior committed panel hardcoded 3 event types (elasticsearch_index_failed, model_call_error, entity_extraction_failed), and 2 of those 3 went dead 24-55 days ago (model_call_error last emitted 2026-06-07; entity_extraction_failed last emitted 2026-05-07) -- so the panel visually showed errors declining toward zero, which was actually just instrumentation churn, not improving health. Verified live over the last 7 days: 381 real error/failure events, dominated by elasticsearch_index_failed (170), generic error (107, level=ERROR asyncio/connector cleanup warnings), and slm_health_probe_http_error (90). This wildcard query self-adapts to future event-type churn instead of silently going stale again.

targets.query: (event_type: *error* or event_type: *failed*) and not event_type: error_monitor*

panels.title: State transitions
panels.description: Count of orchestrator state_transition events over time, broken down by originating state (from_state). Query unchanged from the original (it was already correct) -- this is a value-confirm pass. Verified live: alive today (13,772 total docs, last emitted 2026-07-01T11:40), with exactly 3 distinct from_state values -- llm_call (5,818), tool_execution (4,562), init (3,392). Orchestrator is transitioning states normally.
